title: Direct Knowledge Of Allah 19th Degree 1st Truth Proofs Of The 7 Attributes Especially Life

questions.question: Which attribute makes Allah known by revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: Which attribute makes Allah known by His works and what He creates?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: What is each work compared to in the passage?
questions.answer: A word with a visible form.

questions.question: What does this great “book” show about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is powerful and glorious.

questions.question: Which attribute is shown through things that are wise, orderly, and balanced?
questions.answer: Knowledge.

questions.question: Through what kinds of created things is Knowledge shown?
questions.answer: Through created things that are arranged, guided, decorated, and made different from each other.

questions.question: Which attribute is proved by its own signs and also by signs of the other attributes?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: Which creatures are named as witnesses for Life?
questions.answer: Living things.

questions.question: What do living things reflect like mirrors?
questions.answer: Many proofs of Allah’s attributes.

questions.question: What kind of Essence does Life make known?
questions.answer: An ever-living and self-sustaining Essence.

questions.question: Why does the passage say the universe keeps changing?
questions.answer: To show fresh and different displays and designs.

questions.question: What does the changing universe become because of this?
questions.answer: A big mirror made of many small mirrors.

questions.question: Which other attributes also make the Most Sacred Essence known?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: How do the attributes help us know more than just Allah’s existence?
questions.answer: They also show that He is living and everlasting.

questions.question: Why is knowledge a sign of life in the passage?
questions.answer: Because knowing belongs to one who lives.

questions.question: Why are hearing and seeing linked to life?
questions.answer: Because hearing and seeing belong to a living being.

questions.question: Why is Life called the foundation and source of the attributes?
questions.answer: Because many other attributes point to it and depend on it.

questions.question: What attribute lets people know Allah through messages given from Him?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: What attribute shows Allah through skillful things He brings into existence?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: In the passage, what are created effects like?
questions.answer: They are like meaningful words you can see.

questions.question: What picture is given for the cosmos?
questions.answer: It is pictured as a book spread from one end to the other.

questions.question: Who is made known by this “book” of the cosmos?
questions.answer: Allah, the Powerful One full of glory.

questions.question: What does the attribute of Knowledge show through every well-arranged creature?
questions.answer: One holy and single Essence.

questions.question: What special qualities in creation point to Knowledge?
questions.answer: Wisdom, order, balance, direction, beauty, and distinctness.

questions.question: Besides its own proofs, what other signs support Life?
questions.answer: Signs of Power, Knowledge, and the other attributes.

questions.question: What kind of beings stand as witnesses for Life?
questions.answer: All living beings.

questions.question: What do these living beings help make known about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is eternally living and self-subsisting.

questions.question: What does the attribute of Life do to the cosmos all the time?
questions.answer: It keeps changing it.

questions.question: Why is the cosmos changed again and again?
questions.answer: To bring out new displays and patterns.

questions.question: What do Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking do?
questions.answer: They reveal the Most Sacred Essence too.

questions.question: Do the attributes point only to Allah’s existence, or also to something else?
questions.answer: Also to His life and lastingness.

questions.question: Which attribute can happen only with life: Will or shape?
questions.answer: Will.

questions.question: Which two things are said to belong only to the living?
questions.answer: Hearing and seeing.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect speech with both knowledge and life?
questions.answer: Because speaking belongs to one who knows and lives.

questions.question: What high place does Life have among the attributes?
questions.answer: It is their base, source, and support.

questions.question: Which attribute makes the Most Sacred Essence known through revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: The attribute of Speech.

questions.question: Which attribute makes the Essence known through created works?
questions.answer: The attribute of Power.

questions.question: What does the passage compare these works to?
questions.answer: To outward words.

questions.question: How is the whole cosmos presented?
questions.answer: As a meaningful book.

questions.question: What can a person learn from this great book?
questions.answer: That its Maker is powerful and full of majesty.

questions.question: Through what does the attribute of Knowledge make Allah known?
questions.answer: Through each wise and orderly created thing.

questions.question: What are some signs in creation that point to Knowledge?
questions.answer: Careful order, balance, guidance, beauty, and special features.

questions.question: Is Life proved only by one kind of evidence in the passage?
questions.answer: No. It is proved by many kinds of evidence.

questions.question: Name one kind of evidence besides its own that supports Life.
questions.answer: The signs showing Power.

questions.question: What else besides Power supports Life?
questions.answer: The signs showing Knowledge and the other attributes.

questions.question: Who acts like mirrors for these many proofs?
questions.answer: Living creatures.

questions.question: What do these living creatures show about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is ever-living and self-subsisting.

questions.question: What effect does Life have on the cosmos?
questions.answer: It keeps the cosmos changing.

questions.question: Why are new changes and designs brought out?
questions.answer: To show fresh kinds of display.

questions.question: What does the cosmos become through these many displays?
questions.answer: A huge mirror with countless small mirrors.

questions.question: Which four attributes are listed together after this?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: What do all these attributes together reveal?
questions.answer: The Most Sacred Essence.

questions.question: Why does the passage say purposeful power belongs to the living?
questions.answer: Because acting with purpose shows life.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is Life very strongly proven?
questions.answer: Because many signs in the universe point to it.

questions.question: What does the passage call Life in relation to the other attributes?
questions.answer: Their foundation and source.

questions.question: What is one way Speech makes Allah known?
questions.answer: Through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: What is one way Power makes Allah known?
questions.answer: Through the things Allah skillfully creates.

questions.question: In this passage, a created thing is like what?
questions.answer: A visible word.

questions.question: What object from everyday reading is the universe compared to?
questions.answer: A book.

questions.question: What does this comparison help us understand about Allah?
questions.answer: That the world shows its Maker clearly.

questions.question: Which attribute is seen in the careful planning of creation?
questions.answer: Knowledge.

questions.question: What are created things like when they show Knowledge?
questions.answer: Wise, organized, balanced, guided, and decorated.

questions.question: What attribute is backed up by signs from all the other attributes?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: Which beings are especially used as witnesses for Life?
questions.answer: Animate beings.

questions.question: What do animate beings reflect?
questions.answer: Many proofs from Allah’s attributes.

questions.question: What keeps happening to the cosmos because of Life?
questions.answer: It is continually changed.

questions.question: What is the purpose of these continuing changes?
questions.answer: To show new forms and patterns.

questions.question: Into what kind of mirror is the cosmos turned?
questions.answer: A giant mirror made up of many smaller mirrors.

questions.question: Which attributes are named with Seeing and Hearing?
questions.answer: Willing and Speaking.

questions.question: What do these attributes point to besides Allah’s existence?
questions.answer: His life and never-ending being.

questions.question: Why does seeing point to life?
questions.answer: Because seeing belongs to one who is alive.

questions.question: Compared with the cosmos, how many proofs does Life have in the passage?
questions.answer: Seven times as many.

questions.question: Why is Life called the support of the Supreme Name?
questions.answer: Because it is the root and support of the attributes.

questions.question: Which attribute is connected with revelation and inspiration?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: Which attribute is connected with works and effects in creation?
questions.answer: Power.

questions.question: What does the passage say these works are similar to?
questions.answer: To words taking shape.

questions.question: What large picture does the passage use for the cosmos?
questions.answer: A book that can be read.

questions.question: What does reading this “book” teach about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is powerful and majestic.

questions.question: Which attribute is shown by the wisdom and order in created things?
questions.answer: Knowledge.

questions.question: What does Knowledge make known through every creature?
questions.answer: One sacred Essence.

questions.question: What attribute is supported by the proofs of Power and Knowledge too?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: What kind of beings give witness to Life?
questions.answer: Living beings.

questions.question: What job do these living beings do in the passage?
questions.answer: They act like mirrors for many proofs.

questions.question: What two big truths about Allah does Life make known here?
questions.answer: That He is eternally living and self-subsisting.

questions.question: Why does the passage say the cosmos is always being changed?
questions.answer: So new signs and designs can appear.

questions.question: What does the cosmos become after these many changes?
questions.answer: A highest mirror made of countless little mirrors.

questions.question: Which attributes are said to reveal Allah just as the cosmos does?
questions.answer: Seeing, Hearing, Willing, and Speaking.

questions.question: What do the attributes clearly show about Allah’s Essence?
questions.answer: That it truly has life and remains forever.

questions.question: Why is hearing a sign of life?
questions.answer: Because hearing belongs to a living one.

questions.question: Why is will a sign of life?
questions.answer: Because willing happens only with life.

questions.question: How strong is the proof for Life, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Very strong, with proofs more numerous than the cosmos.

questions.question: What place does Life have among the attributes?
questions.answer: It is the base and source of them.

questions.question: Through what does Speech make Allah known?
questions.answer: Through revelation and inspiration.

questions.question: Through what does Power make Allah known?
questions.answer: Through His skillful works and their results.

questions.question: In the passage, each created effect is like what?
questions.answer: Like a shaped word.

questions.question: How is the cosmos described from one end to the other?
questions.answer: As a living, meaningful book.

questions.question: What kind of Lord does this “book” describe?
questions.answer: A Powerful Possessor of Glory.

questions.question: Which attribute is shown by things that are wise and balanced?
questions.answer: Knowledge.

questions.question: What has Allah’s Knowledge done to creatures in the passage?
questions.answer: It has directed them, managed them, adorned them, and made them distinct.

questions.question: Which attribute has proofs from itself and from all the others?
questions.answer: Life.

questions.question: What groups of signs are named as supporting Life?
questions.answer: Signs of Power, signs of Knowledge, and signs of the other attributes.

questions.question: Who are called witnesses for Life?
questions.answer: All living beings.

questions.question: What do these witnesses make known about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is eternally alive and self-subsisting.

questions.question: What does Life keep doing to the universe?
questions.answer: It keeps renewing and changing it.

questions.question: What comes from these constant changes?
questions.answer: Fresh displays and many designs.

questions.question: What image is used for the renewed universe?
questions.answer: A great mirror made of countless smaller mirrors.

questions.question: Name two other attributes that reveal the Most Sacred Essence.
questions.answer: Seeing and Hearing.

questions.question: Name two more attributes that reveal the Most Sacred Essence.
questions.answer: Willing and Speaking.

questions.question: What do the attributes show in a very clear way besides existence?
questions.answer: They show life and lastingness.

questions.question: Why does the passage say seeing belongs only to the living?
questions.answer: Because only a living one can truly see.

questions.question: Why is purposeful power a sign of life?
questions.answer: Because acting with purpose belongs to living beings.

questions.question: What final rank is given to Life in this passage?
questions.answer: It is the foundation, source, origin, and support of the other attributes.
